description: Summarise the structural test: catalytic triad geometry across four frames, the NAD versus NADP determinant, and the loss of the UDP-sugar subsite, with pLDDT for every clashing residue
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# per-residue pLDDT for the clashing loops
pl={}
for l in open("AF-Q89GC4.pdb"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA":
        pl[int(l[22:26])]=float(l[60:66])
clash=pd.read_csv("struct_UPG_clashes.csv")
clash['pos']=clash.bll.str.extract(r'(\d+)').astype(int)
clash['backbone']=clash.atom.isin(['N','CA','C','O'])
bb=clash[clash.backbone]
print("backbone clashes:",len(bb),"over residues",sorted(bb.pos.unique()))
print("side-chain clashes:",len(clash)-len(bb))
print("pLDDT of clashing residues:")
for p in sorted(clash.pos.unique()): print(f"  {clash[clash.pos==p].bll.iloc[0]}: pLDDT {pl[p]:.1f}  n_clash {int((clash.pos==p).sum())}  backbone {int(((clash.pos==p)&clash.backbone).sum())}")
print("pLDDT 176-190:", {k:round(pl[k],1) for k in range(176,191)})
print("pLDDT 265-278:", {k:round(pl[k],1) for k in range(265,279)})

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,5))
# panel 1: catalytic triad geometry
frames=["1XEL\nGalE","1EQ2\nHldD","1KEP\nRmlB","1BXK\nGmd"]
y140=[2.30,2.28,2.52,1.77]; k144=[2.89,2.97,2.72,2.35]; s117=[4.22,3.94,5.17,4.26]
refY=[2.87,2.74,np.nan,np.nan]; refK=[2.84,np.nan,np.nan,np.nan]
x=np.arange(4); w=0.26
ax[0].bar(x-w,y140,w,label="bll6421 Tyr140 OH",color="#2b6cb0")
ax[0].bar(x,k144,w,label="bll6421 Lys144 NZ",color="#63b3ed")
ax[0].bar(x+w,s117,w,label="bll6421 Ser117 OG (to C4N)",color="#a0aec0")
ax[0].plot(x-w,refY,"kv",ms=8,label="reference's own Tyr")
ax[0].plot(x,refK,"k^",ms=8,label="reference's own Lys")
ax[0].axhline(3.5,ls="--",c="r",lw=1); ax[0].text(3.05,3.57,"H-bond limit",color="r",fontsize=8,ha="right")
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels(frames); ax[0].set_ylabel("minimum distance (A)")
ax[0].set_title("Catalytic triad is assembled on the nicotinamide ribose\n(distance to NAD/NADP 2'/3'-OH; Ser to C4N)",fontsize=10)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=7.5)
# panel 2: cofactor 2'-position
lab=["GalE Asp31\n-> NAD 2'/3'-OH","bll6421 Asp33\n-> NAD 2'/3'-OH","HldD Lys53\n-> NADP 2'-P","HldD Lys38\n-> NADP 2'-P",
     "bll6421 Leu34\n-> NADP 2'-P","bll6421 nearest base\nArg90 -> NADP 2'-P"]
val=[2.59,2.16,2.72,3.71,2.41,7.97]
col=["#718096","#2b6cb0","#718096","#718096","#dd6b20","#c53030"]
ax[1].bar(range(6),val,color=col)
for i,v in enumerate(val): ax[1].text(i,v+0.15,f"{v:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax[1].axhline(3.5,ls="--",c="r",lw=1)
ax[1].set_xticks(range(6)); ax[1].set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=7.5,rotation=20,ha="right")
ax[1].set_ylabel("minimum distance (A)")
ax[1].set_title("Cofactor call: NAD\nAsp33 sits on the adenosine 2'/3'-OH; no base at the 2'-phosphate",fontsize=10)
# panel 3: UDP-glucose subsite
sub=pd.read_csv("struct_UDPglucose_subsite_substitutions.csv")
cats=["same residue type\nat the position","different residue type","GalE charged contacts\nretained","GalE charged contacts\nlost"]
vals=[int(sub.same_type.sum()),int((~sub.same_type).sum()),1,3]
ax[2].bar([0,1],vals[:2],color=["#2f855a","#c53030"])
ax[2].bar([2.6,3.6],vals[2:],color=["#2f855a","#c53030"])
for i,v in zip([0,1,2.6,3.6],vals): ax[2].text(i,v+0.3,str(v),ha="center")
ax[2].set_xticks([0,1,2.6,3.6]); ax[2].set_xticklabels(cats,fontsize=7.5)
ax[2].set_ylabel("number of positions (of 23)")
ax2b=ax[2].twinx()
ax2b.plot([0.5,3.1],[68,1],"o-",color="#6b46c1",ms=10)
ax2b.text(0.55,64,"68 bll6421 atoms within 2.6 A\nof UDP-glucose in the GalE pose\n(10 of them backbone)",fontsize=8,color="#6b46c1")
ax2b.text(3.05,5,"1 for GalE itself",fontsize=8,color="#6b46c1",ha="right")
ax2b.set_ylabel("steric census (atoms < 2.6 A)",color="#6b46c1"); ax2b.set_ylim(0,85)
ax[2].set_title("UDP-sugar subsite is not conserved\n4/23 contact positions kept, pocket occluded",fontsize=10)
plt.suptitle("bll6421 (Q89GC4) superposed on holo structures of the extended SDR family: triad kept, NAD cofactor, UDP-sugar site lost",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
